phrase.zh: 地表看似安静，板块仍在移动。
phrase.en: The surface seems still while plates move.

visual.zh: 地层边界沿弧线错开，内部亮带提示深处的地质活动。它不是地震风险图，也不对应可定位的断层。
visual.en: Layer boundaries slip along arcs while bright bands hint at activity below. This is neither an earthquake-risk map nor a locatable fault.

background.zh: 地球岩石圈分成彼此相对移动的板块。海底扩张在洋中脊生成新洋壳，其他边界的俯冲又使一些洋壳回到地球内部；变化通常在漫长时间里积累。
background.en: Earth’s lithosphere is divided into plates that move relative to one another. New ocean crust forms at spreading ridges, while subduction returns some crust into Earth’s interior; these changes build over long timescales.

sources.label: US Geological Survey · This Dynamic Earth
